how: Kept by hand. Trash zones, rules and drop off sites from the Ministry of Public Works 2026 Garbage and Recycling Calendar (gov.bm). Recycling is every second week: the anchor dates here are 12 November 2026 (west) and 13 November 2026 (east), which the Government's Remembrance Day notice named as a recycling week, and they agree with the 28 and 29 May dates in its Bermuda Day notice. Public holidays from Official Gazette notice GN0334/2024. When the 2027 waste calendar is published: check the zones, set new anchor dates, move valid_to to the end of 2027 and move review_after on. Help (added 24 Nov 2026): pharmacy hours from phoenixstores.com and peoples.bm, urgent care and emergency details from bermudahospitals.bm. Hours are keyed by weekday number, 0 for Sunday. School (added 24 Nov 2026): Government school dates from the Ministry of Education Parents and Guardians Academic Calendar 2026 to 2027 (moed.bm). Add the 2027 to 2028 calendar when it is published.

recycling.areas: Every second week. West (Thursday) is Sandys, Southampton, Warwick and Paget, plus Tee Street and Kent Avenue. East (Friday) is St George's, Hamilton Parish, Smith's, Pembroke and Devonshire.

rules: Trash is collected once a week. Put it out by 7:30am on your day, and not the night before.
Use bins with lids or tied plastic bags. Paper bags and boxes are not taken.
Recycling is tin, aluminium and glass only. Rinse it and put it in a blue bin or a clear or blue bag.
Tynes Bay Public Drop Off, Palmetto Road, Devonshire, is open 7am to 7pm every day, and 9am to noon on public holidays. Closed Christmas Day. Free for up to four bags of household trash.
Garden waste goes to Marsh Folly, Pembroke: weekdays 7:30am to 4pm, Saturday to noon.
Metal, appliances, tyres and rubble go to the Airport Waste Facility, Cahow Way, St George's: weekdays 7:30am to 4pm, Saturday to noon.
Questions about a missed collection: 292-7454. The City of Hamilton and the old town of St George's run their own collections.
